scope: Offline input-send batching evidence. Original raw reports and their failure flags remain authoritative.

definitions.formal: 180 <= sampled logical frame < report.parameters.limit; startup and tail are retained separately.
definitions.callback: A recorded actual rAF entry/exit contains exactly one sampled onGameFrame call. Browser rAF timestamp is not used as actual entry.
definitions.oldThenFresh: Consecutive local input intents inside that callback: same session/sender/destination, senderFrame and ackFrame; latestFrame increments by one.
definitions.strictSubset: Also sequence increments by one modulo uint32, ackSequence and frameAdvantage equal, and the second input range covers all of the first.
definitions.firstAdvertisement: First observed intent containing each local input frame in its session; it is not native sampling time.
definitions.sequenceException: An observation boundary, duplicate, transport rejection or other send can explain a sequence discontinuity. No discontinuity is relabeled as packet loss.
definitions.repair: Relay counts cannot prove reliable RTC repair. Focused channel/session/Adonis gates and a separately covered RTC path are needed for that contract.

cpuThrottle.scope: openProbe and after-open counters precede CPU throttling; subsequent netplay setup and first game callback use the configured per-side rates.

hostObservation.scope: valid/complete describe sampling, not an idle or controlled host. No game sample is excluded according to host load.

captureToIntent.reason: No native sample completion/Capture-entry timestamp. firstWireAt is inside the send observer; subtracting it from intent measures observer work, not native capture latency.

repairs.scope: Sample counter deltas include independent pumps between samples. Relay SendRepairTo is unsupported; zero repairs on relay does not exercise reliable RTC repair.

transport.scope: Complete header, FNV32 and destination keys; equal keys are matched as FIFO occurrences, never deduplicated. intentToWsSend includes all API attempts; downstream matching excludes synchronous thrown sends and preserves their references separately. WS send is API entry; relay receive is its JS callback entry; poll-copy is a positive native buffer copy, not SessionChannel acceptance. Cross-process clock error is not calibrated; negative deltas remain visible. All unmatched events, including stop-window tails, remain in this output.

input.scope: Offline tape checks cover observed local wire button sequences. The frozen harness also checks each observed analog input for neutrality, but this JSON has no full input payload to independently repeat that check. Matching FNV/header packets is not bitwise payload proof. Canonical hashes are compared only at identical confirmed frames; captures/corrections/model time are not browser CPU performance.

comparisons.scope: The same input tape and confirmed hashes establish workload/state correspondence where covered. Callback counts and rollback depth may still differ. Header-pair reductions are observed send-path behavior, not a CPU speedup or direct proof of lower capture latency. Independent pumps and reliable repair remain separate obligations. Wall-clock input runs are never declared the same tape.

limitations: No native capture completion timestamp exists in these source reports.
The sender observer validates the wire tape and sets the next synthetic keys before intent; its work is inside measured send paths.
Hash/packet summaries do not replace complete game correctness, response coverage, audio or 4x effective-new-picture acceptance.
Report errors are counted without copying external resource URLs or queries. No original failed run or exceptional timing is discarded.

review.formalFrameScope: 180 <= sampled frame < 900; both complete 900-frame local wire tapes and all seven same-frame confirmed hashes match across runs

retainedP1Pair.interpretation: Consistent with the intentionally preserved 80 ms due-repair path in SessionChannel::SendInputs. The raw trace does not export the branch decision. Retain this pair; do not claim all pairs became zero.

candidateP2OtherMultipleIntents.interpretation: Two genuine fresh logical ticks per callback, not old-tail duplication.

tailAccounting.interpretation: All original unmatched references remain below. A message without poll-copy remains incomplete evidence, even when it is an ACK-only ending-window packet.

limitations: No direct native capture-completion timestamp is recorded; RAF-entry to first wire advertisement is not capture-to-intent latency.
Both routes are relay. Zero repair counters do not exercise the reliable RTC repair path.
Same tape and parameters do not make a causal CPU comparison: Wasm and six diagnostic helper identities differ; host observations are retained without filtering.
Cross-process clocks were not calibrated. The original negative stage deltas remain present.
This verifies the intended reduction in redundant ordinary sends; it does not establish a release FPS improvement or fix of long RAF gaps.
